## Reliability Overview

The Expedition 4th gen is the closest Ford parallel to the Explorer 6th gen (2020-2025) reliability story: high recall count, dominant single engine, and a stack of sequential re-recalls where the fix itself was performed incorrectly. The 2018-2025 file carries 46 recalls across eight model years and lands three "incorrectly repaired" re-recalls within that base. The 3.5L EcoBoost twin-turbo V6 (370 hp through 2022, post-refresh code for 2023+) covers the entire generation with no alternative powertrain. Across 2018-2025, the Expedition accumulates 1,831 NHTSA complaints, 46 recalls, 44 crashes, 22 fires, 89 complaints that report an injury, and none that report a death. [...] 3.2
